ORRIN FLATS, 14 March 2031 (Meridian Brief) — The Vantry maglev prototype reached a top speed of 540 km/h during its final acceleration trial at the Orrin Flats test corridor, people familiar with the matter said.

The train held that speed for 38 seconds over a 21 km stretch of the 48 km guideway.

Dr. Selwyn Marachek, chief test engineer at the Vantry Transit Authority, oversaw the run and confirmed the reading, those people said.

The figure appears in the authority's Trial Report VTA-MX-17, released after independent verification of both the onboard and trackside speed logs. The two sets of data matched, according to the report.

The run was the last in the acceleration series at the corridor.

The Vantry Transit Authority has not said when the prototype will enter its next testing phase.

Further details were not immediately available.
